subject: Materials Science
title: Eddy Current Testing
description: Learn Eddy Current Testing in one minute.

hook.text: Pass a coil over a metal surface and cracks change the coil's impedance — no contact, no couplant, no mess.

buildup.text: An alternating magnetic field induces eddy currents in the metal — defects disrupt their flow pattern.

discovery.text: The coil senses changes in impedance caused by disrupted currents — mapping cracks in real time.

twist.text: Eddy currents only penetrate a few millimeters — deeper defects need ultrasound or radiography.

climax.text: Aircraft fuselage skins are scanned with eddy current arrays — finding fatigue cracks around rivet holes.

punchline.text: Invisible currents in metal betray hidden cracks — electricity as inspector.

quiz.question: What limits eddy current testing?
options: Eddy currents penetrate only a few millimeters, missing deep defects
